map.SARA是评估小脑性共济失调严重程度的国际标准量表，包含8项检查，总分0-40分: SARA is an international standard scale for cerebellar ataxia severity, with 8 items, total 0-40. Gait assessment requires walking 10 m on flat ground (incl. turn).
map.SARA 小脑共济失调量表总分 = 8 项检查（步态/站姿/坐姿/言语/指鼻/跟: SARA cerebellar ataxia total = sum of 8 items (gait/stance/sit/speech/finger-nose/heel-knee-shin/alternating/heel-shin slide), max 40; <=3 mild, <=8 mild-moderate, <=15 moderate, <=30 severe, >30 extremely severe.
map.SARA适用于各种类型小脑性共济失调评估: SARA applies to all types of cerebellar ataxia assessment
map.步态评估需在平坦地面行走10米(含转身): Gait assessment needs 10 m walk on flat ground (incl. turn)
map.0-3轻度 4-8轻中度 9-15中度 16-30重度 >30极重度: 0-3 mild 4-8 mild-moderate 9-15 moderate 16-30 severe >30 extremely severe
map.常用于疾病进展监测和临床试验疗效评估: Often used for disease progression monitoring and clinical trial efficacy
map.8 动作合计 22 /40：明显共济失调，步态与指鼻试验受累重。: 8 movements total 22 /40: marked ataxia, gait and finger-nose heavily involved.
map.40 分制（步态 8、站立 6、坐位 4、言语 6、其余各 4），越高越差。: 40-point scale (gait 8, stance 6, sit 4, speech 6, others 4 each), higher = worse.
map.同脊髓小脑共济失调评估思路，分项权重一致。: Same spinocerebellar ataxia assessment approach, consistent item weights.
map.SARA包含步态、站立、坐位、言语、追视、鼻指测试和交替轮替运动8项检查，总分0: SARA includes 8 items (gait, stance, sit, speech, pursuit, nose-finger test, alternating movements), total 0-40, widely used for hereditary ataxia staging, efficacy and progression monitoring.
